plays.name: Field Through (IF back)

plays.name: Drop-step Left, Get In Front

plays.note: No coach audio. Lateral backhand route, then a throw back to first after the feet are set.

plays.name: Routine Cut the Distance, Boot Barehand, Arm Fake

plays.note: No coach audio. Cues follow the drill: charge, field at the body, the ball boots out, barehand, arm fake.

plays.note: No coach audio. Forward-right approach at the same pace as Ball Left, Routine Cut the Distance.

plays.name: Rake Through Backhand

plays.note: No coach audio. Medium-soft ball to the backhand, often a second baseman on a ball up the middle.

sequences.title: Field through and the sweeping backhand
sequences.description: From a deeper start, work through the ball, drop-step left to get in front, then sweep the backhand and set your feet.

sequences.title: Routine and lateral positioning
sequences.description: Field a routine hop, then get in front of balls to your left and right.

sequences.title: Adjust and crossover shuffles
sequences.description: Close ground and adjust on the routine ball. Drop-step and crossover into the forehand and the backhand.

sequences.title: Infield-in field-through and shuffles
sequences.description: From an infield-in start, field through the ball, then drop-step and shuffle to either side.

sequences.title: Slow roller and crossover routes
sequences.description: Charge the two-handed slow roller to your left. Drop-step to get in front, then crossover into the backhand.

sequences.title: Come-and-get-it and the jump throw
sequences.description: Charge the one-handed routine ball, lengthen the hop on the backhand, then jump-throw on the run.

sequences.title: Chopper, forehand run, and field-with
sequences.description: Two-hand the chopper above the knee, set your feet on the forehand run, then field with the ball on a deep drop.

sequences.title: Hinge, charging backhand, and ball right
sequences.description: Hinge into the backhand and gather. Charge the softer backhand and throw on the run, then one-hand the ball to your right and set your feet.

sequences.title: Boot recovery, ball right, and rake-through
sequences.description: Charge a routine ball, recover the boot barehanded, and arm-fake. Cut the distance on a ball to your right, then rake through a medium-soft backhand.

sequences.title: Routine gather and urgent charging
sequences.description: Gather on the routine ball. On the do-or-die plays, charge and field with one hand or barehand.

sequences.title: Chopper, ball-left, and no-step backhand
sequences.description: Charge the one-handed chopper below the knee, close on the ball to your left, and throw without an extra step on the backhand.

sequences.title: Boot, sit-back, and set feet
sequences.description: Recover a boot and throw. Sit back on the chopper for a quick exchange, then set your feet on the lateral backhand.
